glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) (Shuowen), indicating a ladle-shaped dipper or cup used to measure grain (see below) held by hand. See also 升.
shuowen: Pictogram (象形) (Shuowen), indicating a ladle-shaped dipper or cup used to measure grain (see below) held by hand.
senses: [dǒu] (historical) a dipper or cup-like object, used in ancient China as a wine vessel
[zhǔ] A unit of measure for liquids.
[zhǔ] alternative form of 枓 (“ladle or spoon used for scooping water”)
(Xiamen Hokkien, Quanzhou Hokkien, &, Taiwanese Hokkien) snare; trap (especially with a trigger)
